questions.question: The Chilika Lake is located to the south of the ___________ delta.
questions.questionHtml: The Chilika Lake is located to the south of the ___________ delta.
questions.solution:
Chilika Lake, the largest coastal lagoon in India and the second largest in the world, is located in the state of Odisha.

It lies to the south of the Mahanadi River delta, along the east coast of India.

· The Mahanadi River flows into the Bay of Bengal, and its delta region is north of Chilika Lake.

· Chilika is known for its rich biodiversity, particularly migratory birds, and is designated as a Ramsar Site.

questions.question: Which country is the only country in the world to have both tigers and lions?
questions.questionHtml: Which country is the only country in the world to have both tigers and lions?
questions.solution: India is the only country in the world where both tigers and lions are found in their natural habitat. Tigers are found in various regions of India, while lions are primarily found in the Gir Forest National Park in the state of Gujarat.

questions.question: In terms of area, India is the _____ largest country in the world.
questions.questionHtml: In terms of area, India is the _____ largest country in the world.
questions.solution: In the global ranking of countries by land area, India holds the 7th position. Its total landmass measures around 3.28 million square kilometres, representing about 2.4% of the world's total geographical area.

questions.question: Which is the largest river island in the world?
questions.questionHtml: Which is the largest river island in the world?
questions.solution: Majuli, in the Brahmaputra River in India, a non-coastal landmass between two banks of a river, is recognised by the Guinness Book of World Records as the world's largest inhabited riverine island, at 880 square kilometres (340 sq mi).

questions.question: According to 'World Language Database Ethnologue-2019', brought out in February 2020, which Indian language is the third most spoken language of the world in 2019?
questions.questionHtml: According to 'World Language Database Ethnologue-2019', brought out in February 2020, which Indian language is the third most spoken language of the world in 2019?
questions.solution: Hindi is the 3rd most spoken language of the world in 2019 with 615 million speakers. The 22nd edition of the world language database Ethnologue stated English at the top of the list with 1,132 million speakers. Chines Mandarin is at the second position with 1,117 million speakers.

questions.question: As of 2020, which country has the largest proven coal reserves in the world?
questions.questionHtml: As of 2020, which country has the largest proven coal reserves in the world?
questions.solution:
The United States of America held the largest proven coal reserves in 2020.

Key Data (BP Statistical Review 2020):

· Proven Coal Reserves: 248 billion tonnes (23% of global reserves).

· Major Coal Basins: Powder River Basin (Wyoming/Montana), Appalachian Basin.

· Types: Primarily bituminous and sub-bituminous coal.

Top 5 Countries (2020):

· United States - 248 bn tonnes

· Russia - 162 bn tonnes

· Australia - 149 bn tonnes

· China - 138 bn tonnes

· India - 108 bn tonnes

questions.question: The Hirakud Dam is built near the city of ______ in Odisha.
questions.questionHtml: The Hirakud Dam is built near the city of ______ in Odisha.
questions.solution: The Hirakud Dam, built across the Mahanadi River in Sambalpur district of Odisha, is the longest in the world, with a length of 4.8 km. It was one of the first initial projects that an independent India undertook. The first Prime Minister of the country, Pandit Jawahar Lal Nehru, put the first piece of concrete of the dam on April 12, 1948.

questions.question: Match the lakes in column A with their countries in column B. Column - A Column - B i. Lake Baikal a. Uganda and Tanzania ii. Lake Superior b. Canada and USA iii. Lock Lamond c. Scotland iv. Lake Victoria d. Russia
questions.questionHtml:
Match the lakes in column A with their countries in column B.

Column - AColumn - B
i. Lake Baikala. Uganda and Tanzania
ii. Lake Superiorb. Canada and USA
iii. Lock Lamondc. Scotland
iv. Lake Victoriad. Russia
questions.solution:
i. Lake Baikal is located in Russia.

It's the world's deepest and oldest freshwater lake, located in Siberia.

ii. Lake Superior is shared between Canada and the United States.

It is the largest of the Great Lakes of North America and is situated on the border between these two countries.

iii. Loch Lomond is located in Scotland.

It is one of the largest and most famous lochs (lakes) in Scotland, known for its natural beauty and popularity as a tourist destination.

iv. Lake Victoria is shared by Uganda and Tanzania, as well as Kenya.

It is one of the African Great Lakes and is the largest lake in Africa by surface area.

Hence, correct relation is: i-d, ii-b, iii-c, iv-a.

questions.question: Where do you find the temple of Angkorwat?
questions.questionHtml: Where do you find the temple of Angkorwat?
questions.solution:
Angkor Wat is an enormous Buddhist temple complex located in northern Cambodia. It was originally built in the first half of the 12th century as a Hindu temple. Spread across more than 400 acres, Angkor Wat is said to be the largest religious monument in the world.

Originally dedicated to the Hindu god Vishnu, Angkor Wat became a Buddhist temple by the end of the 12th century.

questions.question: Which is the correct sequence of oceans according to size (from largest to smallest)?
questions.questionHtml: Which is the correct sequence of oceans according to size (from largest to smallest)?

options.text: Pacific Ocean > Antarctic Ocean > Indian Ocean > Atlantic Ocean
options.html: Pacific Ocean > Antarctic Ocean > Indian Ocean > Atlantic Ocean

options.text: Pacific Ocean > Indian Ocean > Antarctic Ocean > Atlantic Ocean
options.html: Pacific Ocean > Indian Ocean > Antarctic Ocean > Atlantic Ocean

options.text: Pacific Ocean > Atlantic Ocean > Indian Ocean > Antarctic Ocean
options.html: Pacific Ocean > Atlantic Ocean > Indian Ocean > Antarctic Ocean

options.text: Pacific Ocean > Indian Ocean > Atlantic Ocean > Antarctic Ocean
options.html: Pacific Ocean > Indian Ocean > Atlantic Ocean > Antarctic Ocean

questions.solution:
The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth, followed by the Atlantic Ocean, the Indian Ocean, and then the Antarctic Ocean. This sequence is based on their respective sizes, with the Pacific Ocean covering the largest area of the Earth's surface, followed by the Atlantic Ocean, Indian Ocean, and Antarctic Ocean in decreasing order.

Hence, Pacific Ocean > Atlantic Ocean > Indian Ocean > Antarctic Ocean.

questions.question: As of March 2020, which of the following solar power plants is the biggest plant in the world, with total installed capacity of 2,245 MW?
questions.questionHtml: As of March 2020, which of the following solar power plants is the biggest plant in the world, with total installed capacity of 2,245 MW?
questions.solution:
· As of March 2020, the world's largest solar power plant was the Bhadla Solar Park in Rajasthan, India, with a total installed capacity of 2,245 MW.

· Located in the arid Thar Desert near Phalodi in the Jodhpur district, it covers an area of approximately 56 square kilometers and is among the largest solar parks globally.

questions.question: Name the first female amputee to climb Mount Everest.
questions.questionHtml: Name the first female amputee to climb Mount Everest.
questions.solution: Arunima Sinha is the world's first female amputee to climb Mount Everest. On 21st May 2013, Arunima reached the summit of Everest as part of the Tata Group Sponsored Eco Everest Expedition, becoming the first female amputee to scale the famous mountain. In 2014, Arunima's book, 'Born Again on the Mountain' was published, the launch was attended by the Prime Minister of India, Narenda Modi.In 2015, she was awarded Padma Shri, the fourth highest civilian award in India. She is also the recipient of the Tenzing Norgay Highest Mountaineering Award in India.

questions.question: Which of the following is a landlocked salt lake in Southwest Asia between Israel and Jordan?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is a landlocked salt lake in Southwest Asia between Israel and Jordan?
questions.solution:
The Dead Sea is a landlocked salt lake located between Israel and Jordan. It is one of the saltiest bodies of water in the world and is famous for its high buoyancy.

· Don Juan Pond: A hypersaline lake in Antarctica.

· Aral Sea: A shrinking lake between Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan.

· Caspian Sea: The largest inland sea but not a salt lake.

Thus, the correct answer is Dead Sea.
